issue: docs/surface-area-backlog.md SR8, the last stack level and the only circular one

landed_against.rule: R-17: this slice declares every diff path here and re-captures the baselines it moved in the same commit.

what_landed: Rampage's stack level walks its own cadence and its own damage off one rule: the scheduler recomputes the cooldown per cast (stack_scaled_cooldown) and the cast pricing walks the damage through the Case 6 stack_window.
why: The level decides the cadence and the cadence decides the level, which read as circular for three sessions. A FORWARD walk has no circle in it: the stacks a cast leaves behind are known from the casts already placed, and it is that level which decides when the next one lands.

The cached cooldown row is the source and had been misread all along. It holds four values indexed BY RAMPAGE STACKS, which its own units say, 4 / 3.25 / 2.5 / 1.75. extract_cooldown indexed it by RANK, so slot_extract's documented _axis_index fall-through priced every rank at the fully stacked 1.75s, and the module then subtracted a further 0.75 per stack on top of that. The Q cooldown leaf 1.75 -> 4.0 is that double count coming out.

The double count surfaced as a hang, not as a number: a stated three stacks reached a zero cooldown and the scheduler recast forever at one instant. The row is read by stack level now and nothing is subtracted, so no level can reach zero.

Ten seconds at full uptime: 9 casts and 1271.9 damage at a stated zero, 11 and 1439.5 derived, 12 and 1570.7 at a stated three. The derived reading sits between the ends because it starts at the unstacked cooldown and works down.
The Q totals fall because the unstacked cooldown is 4s and not 1.75s, so fewer casts fit. All 20 pair leaves are his. No coupled leaf moves: no coupled roster holds him.
